title: Temporal consistency and optical flow basics
hook: What optical flow really measures, how to tell motion from flicker, and what core ComfyUI does with both.

verified.claim: VideoConv3d pads kernel_size - 1 frames before the clip and none after, so its output depends only on the present and the past.
Core's OpticalFlowLoader loads a RAFT checkpoint from models/optical_flow and never downloads one. VOIDWarpedNoise uses it.
RAFT is a deep network for optical flow, per its abstract.
Lucas-Kanade recovered small motion in the lab, and failed at large motion.
nm_video validates and runs on a CPU.

unchecked: We did not run the VOID nodes or RAFT. We read what they load and call.
The first version of this lesson named specific papers for Cosmos and Genmo. We could not confirm those numbers and removed them.
A causal VAE has no future to leak from, but that alone doesn't prove less flicker. We make no claim that causal video VAEs flicker less.
